setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: Use the same microphone, the same room and headphones every time.
setup.headphones_required: Headphones are required. Test audio must not reach the microphone.
setup.headphone_help: A short tone will play. With headphones on, the microphone should not hear it.
setup.headphone_leak: The microphone hears the test tone (leak {{db}} dB). Put on headphones and try again.
setup.need_all: Complete the microphone, noise and headphone checks first.

runner.intro_body: {{tasks}} tasks. Each task explains itself first. Recording starts and stops on its own.
runner.listen_once: Listen carefully. You will hear this once.
runner.axb_question: Was X the same as A or B?

quality.clipping: Clipping: the signal is too loud at peaks. Lower the microphone gain.
quality.too_quiet: Too quiet. Move closer to the microphone or raise the gain.
quality.noisy: Low signal-to-noise ratio. Background noise is high.
quality.silent: Nothing was recorded. Check the microphone.

done.title: Sitting complete
done.body: Thank you. Your recordings are being uploaded and processed.
done.uploads_pending: Still uploading {{n}} recording(s). Keep this page open.
done.uploads_done: All recordings are on the server.
